lines.description: Harness cable, ferrules and strain-relief materials
lines.constraints: Lengths and insulation grades unselected. Battery6mm2;arms4mm2;drive/chopper1.5mm2;lift/5V1mm2;PC0.75mm2;NTC0.25mm2. Chopper pair neither terminal isground.

lines.fixed_interface: Use the already selected PCB headers and their specified mating plugs. Harness, ferrules and restraints are external; no PCB holes or connector changes.

lines.description: Insulated live-bus covers and mechanical restraint
lines.constraints: No dimensions/ordercode released. Independent mechanical support;>=15mmclearance belowPCB forbar/clamp stack;>=25mm screwdriver/lug access. See ../rev-a/manufacturing/MECHANICAL_BUILD.md.

lines.fixed_interface: Independent enclosure-mounted insulating support and guards; use the existing four PCB mounting holes. At least 15 mm below PCB and planned 25 mm axial M5 tool access; preserve antenna keepout.

lines.description: Normally-open momentary power button and harness
lines.constraints: Dry contact toJ20; noexternal voltage; exactswitch andmatingharness unselected.
lines.lifecycle: Not applicable until manufacturer part selected
lines.fixed_interface: Normally-open dry contact via existing J20 connector and matching cable; inject no external voltage.
lines.closure_evidence: Select switch/mating harness, confirm pinout and power-button/rearm behavior with a current-limited motorless fixture.

lines.description: Deenergized-open motion permission relay/contact and harness
lines.constraints: J22 loop3.3V only; no24V injection orpermanent actuator-test jumper. Final emergency-stop design unaccepted.
lines.lifecycle: Not applicable until manufacturer part selected
lines.fixed_interface: Existing J22 3.3 V permission loop; deenergized contact must be open. No 24 V injection or permanent bypass jumper.
lines.closure_evidence: Select and accept external emergency-stop/permission circuit and harness; verify open/unpowered fault forces Motion OFF before actuator enable.

lines.constraints: Exact fuse family/interrupt rating/time-current curve andholder unselected; must close beforebattery attachment.
lines.lifecycle: Not applicable until manufacturer part selected
lines.fixed_interface: External 60 A battery fuse and holder upstream of J1; neither mounts on the PCB.
lines.closure_evidence: Select exact DC-rated fuse/holder, interruption rating and time-current curve for the pack/wiring; verify before battery attachment.

lines.constraints: Actual converters and inputcapacitance/transient ratings unselected; not included inon-board eFuse ordercodes.
lines.lifecycle: Not applicable until manufacturer part selected
lines.fixed_interface: External PC input at J9, logic converter input at J10 and regulated 5 V return at J11; lift input at J8. Use fixed Phoenix headers/mates. No converter module footprint exists on this PCB.
lines.closure_evidence: Select actual modules, including China-sourced modules if desired; verify wiring, 27.5-42 V operating input, transients, input capacitance/inrush, 5 V output and isolation/return behavior against POWER_STAGE and bring-up limits before connecting them.
